policy.applied: Each tab in at most one group (first placement wins, unknown ids ignored). Omitted tabs and tabs in a group named "Review Later" (any case) are unassigned. At most ten groups, the Review Later pool counting as one when any tab is unassigned: the largest groups stay (ties by first appearance), the tabs of the rest are unassigned.
policy.tasked: Pairwise F1 over pairs of tabs with a gold task; unassigned tabs are singletons.
policy.all: Pairwise F1 over every tab; a tab without a gold task is a gold singleton; unassigned tabs are singletons.
policy.recorded: As the original reports scored it: plan answers as given (first placement wins, omitted ids singletons, any number of folders), local clusters as the ten largest clusters of 2+ tabs, tasked tabs only.
policy.tenWindows: Every window except dev and life, which were used to draft the plan prompt.
policy.pooled: Sensitivity only: the applied result with all unassigned tabs pooled as one real group.
